title: CLI Telemetry Payload
description: What `npx restless` sends to POST /api/telemetry, once per run, at exit. Anonymous and opt-out: see docs/telemetry.md. This file is the wire contract between lib/telemetry.js and the dashboard's ingest route - the server keeps its own copy of every enum below and rejects nothing, mapping unrecognized values to unknown/other rather than storing them. Kept in step with the code by tests/telemetry-schema.test.js.

schemaVersion.description: Payload version. Bump when a field's meaning changes, not when one is added.

anonymousId.description: Stable per machine, stored in ~/.restless/config.json. A random UUID - never derived from hostname, username, MAC, or working directory, so it counts machines without being able to name one.

sessionId.description: Per run. The server's dedupe key, so a retried flush cannot double-count.

command.description: Which command ran. Anything unrecognized is reported as `unknown` rather than as typed - raw argv is never sent.

flags.description: Allowlisted flag NAMES present in argv. Values never travel with them. Limited to flags that change what the CLI does, not ones that shape its output.

errorCode.description: A code assigned at the raise site. Never a message, a stack, or a server's response text - all of those interpolate URLs, statuses, and sometimes the user's own input.

errorStep.description: Which step the run died in, when known.

byKind.description: Wall-clock totals per timing category, from the spans the run already recorded (lib/timings.js). Totals only - span labels are never sent, since a few are built at call time.

cliName.description: Which bin name dispatched to us. Allowlisted rather than sent through, because it is derived from argv[1].

ci.description: Whether CI is set. Which CI vendor is deliberately not collected - it would not change anything we do.

source.description: Whether a human or a coding agent invoked this run. Mirrors the dashboard's SETUP_SOURCES.

agent.description: Which coding agent, when one identified itself. Already normalized to a slug by lib/env.js.

oasSourceKind.description: How the spec got here. Mirrors oasSource.kind in settings.schema.json.

steps.description: The only event stream in the payload, and only `init` produces one. A strict subset of the dashboard's SETUP_STEPS, in its spelling: `welcome` is redundant with the payload itself (a truer funnel denominator, since it also counts runs that died before the welcome screen) and `account` is the claim, which the server already records with certainty and joined to an identity.
